prompts.full_body: Create one clean 3D modelling reference image based on the FIRST complete character at the far left of the supplied design sheet. Show only this single fully clothed stylized fantasy adventurer, full body from the cap to both boot soles, facing the camera in a relaxed A pose with hands away from the tunic. Preserve the character design and compact four-head-tall proportions, soft rounded face, symmetrical teal eyes, golden layered hair, floppy green fabric cap falling down behind the neck, green collared woven tunic with brown belt and diagonal strap, short trousers, bare knees and chunky brown leather ankle boots. The backpack stays behind the torso. Neutral pale gray studio background, gentle neutral lighting, detailed sculpted game-character materials. This must be a standalone character reference, not a sheet: no text, no border, no additional views, no detached equipment, no scenery. Keep the likeness of the first supplied figure.
prompts.head: Create a polished 3D modelling reference sheet of Link, the friendly elfin hero from The Legend of Zelda, wearing his green forest tunic and long soft green cap. Four consistent head-and-shoulders portraits on a plain warm grey studio background: front, three-quarter, side profile, rear. Same appealing youthful character in each view, neutral expression. Golden blond hair with a natural side part, flowing layered fringe, tapered wisps and many fine strands. Expressive teal-blue eyes set naturally into gently almond-shaped eyelids, softly rounded cheeks, a small rounded chin, delicate nose, natural small mouth, warm peach skin and subtle blush. Long pointed ears with clear natural folds. High-end stylized-realistic cinematic game art, delicate lifelike skin shading, woven cloth and hand stitching, beautifully groomed hair. Soft neutral studio lighting clearly reveals the face anatomy. Accurate aligned views, detailed enough for a Blender sculptor, no text, no scenery, no extra characters. Landscape composition, every ear and the complete draped cap visible.
prompts.boots: A meticulous 3D modelling reference board of Link's brown leather ankle boots for a premium stylized-realistic Kokiri Forest game remake. Show the SAME LEFT BOOT from front, outer side, rear and three-quarter angles, plus a smaller bottom sole view. Empty boots only, no person or feet inside them. Compact sturdy forest-adventure boots: rounded roomy toe box, shaped instep, narrow flexible ankle shaft, thick folded leather cuff, crossed leather laces through brass eyelets, one practical small buckle, visible welt stitching, layered dark leather sole and modest heel. Realistic continuous boot construction, calf opening clearly visible, padded tongue, slight asymmetry appropriate to a left foot, all views coherent. Rich worn chestnut leather with fine grain, creases at the ankle flex point, toe scuffs, burnished edges and hand stitches. Neutral warm-grey studio background, equal scale for main views and shared baseline, soft light revealing form, sharp high-end realistic materials with an appealing stylized silhouette. No text, no arrows, no decoration, no exaggerated giant soles. This is precise visual guidance for modelling natural ankles and boots in Blender.
prompts.outfit: Premium stylized-realistic 3D asset reference board for Link's Kokiri forest clothing and equipment. Objects only on a plain warm-grey studio background, no human or mannequin. Show a beautiful worn forest-green tunic from front and rear with a coherent folded collar, short loose sleeves, simple lace opening, deep olive edging, practical patch pockets and a brown leather waist belt. Beside it show a soft green cloth cap from side and rear: rounded fitted crown and generous flattened drooping tail, center back stitching, natural fabric folds, never a rigid pointed cone. Lower row: a small brown leather backpack with coherent straps and buckles, a small oval wooden shield with a carved red spiral and metal edge, and macro swatches of the same green woven fabric and chestnut leather. Restrained handcrafted fantasy clothing, convincing thickness, frayed edges, fine stitchwork, subtle mossy wear, small-scale fabric weave, physical leather grain, no glossy plastic. Soft neutral studio illumination and crisp readable shapes. Beautiful cinematic game-art quality, a practical coherent model and texture reference for Blender. No labels or lettering.
